title: The band grows and starts playing theaters
summary: By 1931-32 the band was growing into sections and began playing theaters; there were three trumpets.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: No. I don't believe so. Well, -- well, now, see Cootie, the band was already changing character then, because in May, 1932, it was "Drop Me Off At Harlem", and "Stormy Weather". Well, you know, it had become more -- it was no longer the small band with just those few pieces, you know. It must have -- well, I don't know when it began being complete sections. But I guess probably a year or so after you joined. You must have kept adding men, huh?
Yeah. Because I think we started to going out doing theaters.
Well, when you joined, there were three trumpets then, weren't there?
